basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to all international Master's degree programmes taught in English: Faculty of Science & Technology (Computer Science, Computational Science, Embedded Systems, Data Science, Applied Biotechnology, Biomedicine, Chemistry, Physics & Astronomy, Renewable Energy), Faculty of Pharmacy, Faculty of Medicine, Faculty of Social Sciences, and Faculty of Law.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~20 to 25 full tuition scholarships awarded annually to outstanding non-EU students
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition; Pakistani candidates with 3.8+ GPA frequently win awards in engineering, pharmacy, and computer science (typically 2 to 5 awardees/yr)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Full duration of Master's program: 2 years (120 ECTS, contingent on satisfactory study progress in Year 1)

nationality_requirements: Citizens of a country outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland required to pay Swedish tuition fees
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) with outstanding academic standing (equivalent to top 5% of class, minimum 3.75 / 4.00 CGPA or 82%+ aggregate from recognized Pakistani universities like NUST, FAST-NUCES, LUMS, QAU, UET, AKU).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Equivalence evaluated against Swedish higher education grading scale (Pass with Distinction / VG); first-class honors required.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Substantial undergraduate coursework directly aligned with the specific Master's program prerequisites.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or currently in final semester of degree graduating before autumn semester start.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Academic excellence is the sole primary selection criterion; research experience is evaluated through CV.

english_proficiency.notes: English 6 requirement: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 (minimum 5.5 in each band) or TOEFL iBT min 90 (writing 20+).

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: English; Swedish language classes offered free of charge on campus.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Elite international scholars in Computer Science, Biomedicine, Biotechnology, and Physics.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot be held simultaneously with a Swedish Institute (SI) scholarship.

tuition_fee.details: Covers 100% of the full international tuition fee (SEK 120,000 to SEK 160,000/year; total 2-year value SEK 240,000 to SEK 320,000).

admission_application_fee.details: Swedish central application fee (SEK 900) paid by applicant to Universityadmissions.se.

accommodation.details: Scholarship covers tuition fees only; housing is self-funded. Uppsala Housing Office guarantees housing for fee-paying/scholarship international students.
accommodation.amount: Student room rent ~SEK 4,000 to 5,500 / month (~PKR 110,000 to 155,000 / mo)

monthly_stipend.details: Living expenses must be demonstrated for the Swedish Migration Agency (Migrationsverket) student residence permit (~SEK 10,314/month; ~SEK 103,140/year).

airfare.details: International travel expenses to Sweden are borne by the candidate.

visa_fee.details: Swedish residence permit for higher education application fee (SEK 1,500) paid to Swedish Migration Agency.

health_insurance.details: All fee-paying and scholarship students are covered by the Swedish state comprehensive insurance policy (FAS+ / Kammarkollegiet) free of charge.

food_allowance.details: Daily living and meal expenses are self-funded (~SEK 2,500 to 3,500/month).

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Textbooks and course materials paid by student (~SEK 750/month).

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Departments provide advanced laboratories, research instrumentation, and computing clusters for thesis research.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Local Uppsala bus transit or train to Stockholm (UL/SL student monthly pass) paid by student.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single institution (Uppsala University, Sweden - QS World Rank #105, Founded 1477)
participating_institutions: Uppsala University (Angstrom Laboratory, Biomedical Centre - BMC, Campus Gotland)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Scandinavia's oldest university (Nobel Laureates include Svante Arrhenius, Manne Siegbahn, Dag Hammarskjold); Top 100 globally in Life Sciences & Pharmacy.
available_majors: Physics (Nuclear & Particle Physics, Materials Physics, Geophysics)
International Tax Law and EU Law
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's degree with minimum 3.75+ CGPA, detailed course match, program ranked as #1 preference on Universityadmissions.se, and approved English proficiency.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Data Science and Computer Science are highly competitive; Biomedical Sciences and Chemistry have slightly higher scholarship acceptance rates for students with lab backgrounds.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Critical Swedish rule: You MUST rank the Uppsala University Master's program as your FIRST PRIORITY (Priority 1) on Universityadmissions.se before the 15 January deadline. Applications where Uppsala is ranked lower are disqualified from scholarship consideration.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: University Admissions in Sweden (national portal) & Uppsala University Scholarship Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Submit Master's program application on universityadmissions.se by 15 January, pay application fee, then submit online scholarship application via Uppsala portal in mid-January.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Create an account on the Swedish national admissions portal (universityadmissions.se).
Step 2: Select your target Uppsala University Master's degree and rank it as your FIRST CHOICE (Priority 1).
Step 3: Pay the application fee of SEK 900 before the national deadline (1 February).
Step 4: Upload all academic transcripts, degree certificate, syllabus, and English score to universityadmissions.se.
Step 5: Access the Uppsala University Scholarship Application Portal (opens mid-January).
Step 6: Enter your 8-digit Universityadmissions.se application number.
Step 7: Submit the Uppsala scholarship motivation letter explaining your academic ambitions.
Step 8: Submit the scholarship application before the strict deadline (early February).
Step 9: Swedish national admissions results announced in late March.
Step 10: Uppsala scholarship award letters issued in early April to admitted candidates; accept offer and lodge residence permit application.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Dual application: Program application submitted via universityadmissions.se, followed by online scholarship application on Uppsala University's scholarship page.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Not required for general scholarship; submitted only if requested by specific academic department.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Uppsala scholarship motivation statement: Describe your academic achievements, why you chose Uppsala, and how your Master's degree will impact your future scientific career.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Not required for taught MSc; research interests stated in motivation letter.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Detailed academic CV outlining courses, technical projects, thesis abstract, and academic honours.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: No interviews conducted; purely document-based evaluation.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (6.5+, subscores 5.5+) or TOEFL iBT (90+). GRE not required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Color scanned copies of original degrees and transcripts; verified documents must meet Swedish Universityadmissions.se country-specific rules for Pakistan (degrees verified by HEC).
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translations for all non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online via Universityadmissions.se and Uppsala University scholarship portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Clear color copy of valid international passport data page.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure name spelling matches educational certificates.

required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Higher Education Commission (HEC) Pakistan attested documents.

required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Obtain grading explanation from university registrar.

required_documents_checklist.specification: 1-page motivation statement submitted through the Uppsala scholarship portal.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Highlight academic excellence and alignment with Uppsala's research legacy.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Comprehensive academic CV detailing education, projects, technical skills, and honours.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Clean academic layout emphasizing technical skills.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official IELTS Academic (overall 6.5+, subscores 5.5+) or TOEFL iBT (90+) test report.

important_dates_timeline.application_deadline: 15 January (National application deadline on Universityadmissions.se); Early February (Uppsala scholarship portal deadline)
important_dates_timeline.document_submission_deadline: 1 February (Fee payment and document upload deadline)
important_dates_timeline.shortlist_announcement: Late March (Admissions results) & Early April (Scholarship results)
important_dates_timeline.visa_application_window: April - June (Swedish residence permit application via Migrationsverket)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: One annual national intake cycle. You must apply by 15 January and rank Uppsala as #1 choice to be eligible for scholarship.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 60% (Undergraduate GPA, academic grades in relevant subjects, and university reputation)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 15% (Undergraduate research projects, publications, and thesis grade)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 15% (Quality of scholarship motivation letter and academic ambition)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Uppsala University Scholarship Committee comprising faculty representatives, international admissions directors, and vice-rector.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Selection is purely merit-based. Applicants are evaluated based on their academic transcripts and motivation letter. Scholarships are awarded to candidates with the highest academic excellence who have ranked Uppsala as their first choice.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~3,500 to 5,000 non-EU applicants apply to Uppsala University Master's programs
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~20 to 25 full tuition scholarships awarded annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~1% (Achievable for top 5% graduates from NUST, FAST, LUMS, QAU, GIKI with 3.8+ GPA)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates of premier universities with high thesis grades, excellent mathematical and technical backgrounds, and strong motivation.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates in Computer Science, Embedded Systems, Biotechnology, Biomedicine, and Physics.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, India, China, USA, Indonesia, Turkey, Bangladesh.

fake_websites_and_scams: Commercial consultancies claiming they can secure Swedish scholarships for fees. All applications must be submitted via universityadmissions.se.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Universityadmissions.se charges a national SEK 900 application fee. Uppsala University charges NO separate scholarship fee.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Never allow agents to fill out your universityadmissions.se account; personal access and accurate documentation are essential.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Living expenses are NOT covered by the scholarship; students must show proof of ~SEK 10,314/month living funds for the Swedish residence permit.
Flight tickets between Pakistan and Stockholm Arlanda (~PKR 180,000 - 250,000).
Winter clothing and initial settlement expenses (~SEK 5,000 - 8,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: The scholarship includes monthly living stipend. (FACT: Uppsala Global Scholarship is strictly a 100% tuition fee waiver).
CLAIM: You can win the scholarship if Uppsala is your second choice. (FACT: You MUST rank Uppsala as Priority 1 on Universityadmissions.se).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some aggregator websites confuse the Uppsala Global Scholarship with the Swedish Institute (SI) scholarship which covers living costs.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Scholars must maintain satisfactory academic progress and complete at least 75% of credits (45 out of 60 ECTS) in Year 1 to qualify for Year 2 tuition waiver.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical attendance on campus in Uppsala.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual credit completion check conducted by the International Office.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Sweden allows international students to work with no legal limit on hours, provided academic studies remain full-time.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None. International graduates can apply for a 12-month post-study residence permit to seek employment in Sweden.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Tuition waiver is terminated if study progress is unsatisfactory or if student drops out; no clawback of past waived tuition.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Requires approval from the scholarship committee and faculty admissions board.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Strictly limited to the 2-year duration of the Master's program.

data_points_missing_or_unpublished_by_so: Departmental quota breakdown between STEM faculties and Humanities faculties.
Internal cut-off GPA percentiles per individual Master's specialisation.
